description: P1: differential cases of the canonical form (spec/SPEC.md §2). 2,000 valid values, each with the canonical string the TypeScript core writes and its SHA-256: every escape class of §2.2, U+0000 to U+001F, U+007F, U+2028, U+2029, non-ASCII, surrogate pairs, 0, 1 and 2^53 - 1, null, lists to depth 8, and 200 real hop, record, envelope-id and sealed-hash preimages. 300 invalid ones: fractions, negatives, integers from 2^53, booleans, objects, lone surrogates (utf16_hex) and one sparse list.
test_data: Every seed, private key, content key and nonce in this file is test data: each comes from xorshiftRng(20261025) (packages/core/test/support/rng.ts). They are public; never let them protect anything real.
